items.title: Waldren "Frog" Joseph Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: I was studying drum music from Sister Cyril at Copper Crystal School.

ctx.x: Seventeen. Yeah. So he would have died in the thirties then, long ago.

Yeah, over the thirties, yeah. But matter of fact, I had just started playing trombone professionally then. Yeah. Because see, I've been learning music ever since I was, well I say born, you see. Yeah. Because I had polio, and I was full of braces, so he bought all the instruments and put it at the house. So my first instrument was drum. I was studying drum music from Sister Cyril at Copper Crystal School. And, but he always wanted me to learn trombone. Well I did, in the meantime I would learn the trombone, drum…
What did you, what was your very first instrument then?
